recent_en: MISC and joint offerors have proposed to acquire all remaining equity interest in Yinson Holdings Berhad via a members scheme of arrangement, and issued a clarification press notice. The company declared a third tax-exempt interim dividend of 8 sen per share, with ex-date on 11 December 2026. Latest quarter (ended 30 June 2026) saw significant year-on-year growth in revenue and net profit.
notable_en: Proposed acquisition, together with joint offerors, of all remaining equity interest in Yinson Holdings Berhad via a members scheme of arrangement.
Declared a third tax-exempt interim dividend of 8 sen per share.
Significant year-on-year growth in revenue and net profit for the quarter ended 30 June 2026.
risks_en: EPF filed consecutive substantial shareholder changes on 11, 12 and 16 November 2026.
Announcement on 23 November 2026 relates to winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 4,793.4 million, up 65.8% QoQ and 76.1% YoY; net income was MYR 1,154.3 million, up 55.7% QoQ and 148.6% YoY; net margin was 24.1%, lower than 25.6% in the previous quarter.
